record.reason: The method routes compact multilingual sentence-encoder classification by language/resource tier and sometimes invokes translation; its evidence concerns narrow classification systems rather than LLM generation, general LLM serving, or model-compute optimization. The adjacency to cost-aware inference routing is weak and the task/model family mismatch remains unresolved.
record.title: A Cost-Efficient Routing Pipeline for Multilingual Short-Text Classification Using Small Language Models
